name: Qwen3.8 Max
license: Proprietary (open-weight release announced for Qwen3.8-Max and a smaller Qwen3.8-27B; not yet published as of this ingestion)
archDisplay: Sparse MoE, 2.4T total / ~95B active parameters (exact expert count undisclosed), built on the Qwen3.5 architectural foundation, 1M-token context, native text/image/video input
note: Alibaba's new flagship, GA-launched August 3, 2026 after a July 19 preview at WAIC Shanghai — first Max-class Qwen model with a committed (but as of this writing unshipped) open-weight release. 2.4T total parameters is confirmed; ~95B active parameters, the number that actually drives inference cost, comes from third-party technical coverage rather than an official model card, since Alibaba has not yet published one. The launch comparison table is entirely vendor-run with no model card, no independent verification, and no active-parameter disclosure; multiple outlets flagged it as an unverifiable narrative claim rather than a documented launch. Only the least self-serving coding rows (SWE-bench Pro, Terminal-Bench 2.1) are recorded here — the 'best on this chart' claims (OSWorld-Verified 86.1 — claimed ahead of GPT-5.6 Sol Max 83.2, Claude Fable 5 85.0, Gemini 3.1 Pro 76.2 — and PaperBench) are deliberately omitted, which also keeps this entry below the ranking-coverage floor until independent evaluations exist.
